name: decision-compaction
description: Hands back the conversation itself in place of a compaction summary, less the tool calls and results a System One decision model (TypeSafe Jev, Cloudflare Clef, or Jev through OpenRouter) judges no longer needed.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which System One provider decides: "typesafe" (Jev, the default), "cloudflare" (Clef on Workers AI) or "openrouter" (Jev through the OpenRouter gateway). The conversation text and tool inputs are sent to it. Any other value sends nothing anywhere: every compaction then uses the built-in summary and says why.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name for the configured provider. Leave unset for its default: jev-latest (typesafe), clef (cloudflare; clef-flash is the other), ~typesafe/jev-latest (openrouter, which also takes a bare jev id such as jev-latest).

providerDecision.title: Decide the provider per compaction
providerDecision.description: When on, the providers that have credentials and can hold the conversation are compared, and if more than one remains a single routing question picks which decides this compaction. That question goes to Cloudflare whenever its credentials are set, with a profile of the job that includes up to 2,000 characters of your prompts, so a second provider can receive data. Off: always the configured provider.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe key
typesafeApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the TYPESAFE_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter key
openrouterApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the OPENROUTER_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

cloudflareApiToken.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflareApiToken.description: A token allowed to run Workers AI, stored as a secret. When empty, the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflareAccountId.description: The account Workers AI runs under. When empty, the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

keepThreshold.title: Probability to keep
keepThreshold.description: The probability from which a tool call, or its full result, is kept. Lower keeps more.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Newest messages left as they are
preserveRecentMessages.description: How many of the newest messages are never changed. The first message never is.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Context usage, in percent, at which a compaction is requested when a turn ends. 0 turns this off.

minReductionRatio.title: Smallest reduction accepted
minReductionRatio.description: The smallest share of the conversation's characters the decisions must remove; below it the built-in summary is used instead.

maxStateTokens.title: State budget (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Most estimated tokens the description of the conversation may take; it goes out with every request. Held to 85% of the provider's documented limit, and to what the request budget leaves beside the questions of 16 tool calls. A fraction is rounded down.

maxRequestTokens.title: Request budget (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Most estimated tokens one request may take, the description of the conversation and its questions together. Held to 85% of the provider's documented limit, which for openrouter is 27,200, below the default. A fraction is rounded down.

truncateHeadChars.title: Characters kept of a shortened output
truncateHeadChars.description: When a call stays but its full output does not, this many of the output's first characters are kept, followed by a note on what was removed. At 0 only the note is left.
